scope: Known checked scalar math/text facts in bounded source-access discovery

contracts.recognition: STR_LEN is pure and does not invalidate prior source writes as an unknown service
contracts.evaluation: Only bounded known primitive arguments enter a fixed whitelist of existing checked pure helpers; temporary Pythonic mode is restored on success and failure
contracts.order: Analyze arguments once left to right, retaining captured earlier values and internal routine effects; nonreturning arguments skip remaining arguments
contracts.facts: Known results can resolve branches, bounded loops and static addresses; unknown arguments retain ordinary source inputs without invented initial values
contracts.storage: Bounded known INTEGER-to-REAL storage promotion retains the floating category; clipping/narrow conversions may discard constants; unavailable storage cannot supply stale known facts, including SHORT missing state
contracts.failures: Known invalid domains report scalar-call gaps and unavailable results without seeding written destinations
contracts.bounds: Existing source-contract, analysis-step, frame, storage and catalog budgets; at most254 string characters and bounded scalar integer facts
contracts.persistence: Existing generated source contracts, discovery reports, input templates and saved-run formats remain unchanged
contracts.boundary: No target import/execution, execution-context construction, service calls, external callbacks, native/compiler/controller equivalence or runtime-readiness certification
